full_page.content:
1935, September
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 44 Cont.
Sep. 21 Mary Ellen Virgeon - Toronto, Ont. - 18 - Fits ... Remarkably better ... Mrs. Gert. Naly - 27 - Husband refuses to go to Church - with false friends - mother fears divorce ...
Sallie Gage - 32 - fears T.B.
Page 45 Sep. 25 James Templeton - 39 - cancer of liver - dying last June in Harper Hosp. was enrolled June 7th - began at once to improve - went back to work Sept. Ist is here To-night O.K. Deo Gr.
Mrs. Ruby Geraci - 35 - praying ( for family 8 yrs) for important Mrs. M. Gilbert - 51 - Methodist - stomach & nerves and asthma.
N. B. Mildred Lewis - 22 - Cancer of stomach or diaphram; has almost lost voice - able to whisper. All arrangements completed some weeks ago. Girl a fervent convert, the young man the only one of his family to remain a practical Catholic is determined on going ahead with wed- ding. Her aunt who has in a way raised her is atheist ....
Mrs. Esus Michael - 43 - fears goitre operation. Quite nerveous a- bout it .... has 7 small children.
Page 46 Sep. 27 Dorothy Klanow - 20 - broken back - crashed down in air-plane this a.m. Paralysis feared if she lives. Enrolled To-night at 9:30 (50c)
Mrs. Irene Thorp - 46 - C. Scientist (?) - inward tuomer
Mrs. Helen Heiser - 33 - invalid and victim of arthritis for 6 yrs. Lately pain is less severe but stiffness continues.
Margaret Brennan - 68 - flue last winter; long time threatened; now seemingly out of danger.
Bertha Swink - out of work for several years - has prayed but to no avail.
1935, October Page 47 Oct. 1 Hubert R. Andre - 45 - facial trouble - peculiarly wizened -
